title: Hypermarket warehouse slotting and shelf replenishment
dataClassification: Illustrative SKU, store grid and activity volumes; not real store performance

operatingOrganization.businessPurpose: Keep inventory replenishment within safe placement envelopes while reducing modeled travel

operatingFunction.functionLabel: Stockflow from receiving bins to shopping floor

planningWorkstream.scopeOfOptimization: Within six compatible stock-handling areas. Storage and shelving travel are modeled separately.

policyDefinition.baselineRule: Fixed SKU order maps to closest qualifying slots in each stage and area.
policyDefinition.recommendationRule: Maximize trips allocated near the origin via descending trip count within each compatible placement group.
policyDefinition.distanceDefinition: Round-trip Manhattan distance from a fixed stage origin
